item.title: Case against man accused of firing shots at SUV in mobile home park scheduled for trial
item.description: Reader-submitted photo from Aug. 2024 The criminal case of a 50-year-old Batavia resident accused of shooting up a white SUV that looked like a police vehicle parked in a trailer park at 5066 Clinton Street Road, Batavia, in 2024, is likely going to trial.During a Genesee County Court appearance on Wednesday, District Attorney Kevin Finnell told Judge Melissa Lightcap Cianfrini that the defendant, Robert J. Talbot, had previously turned down a plea offer.

item.title: Town planning board moves forward with Holiday Inn, Candlewood Suites renovation
item.description: The town of Batavia Planning Board voted to seek lead agency status on the environmental review for an $8.5 million hotel renovation project at 8250 Park Road.The project by 8250 Park Road LLC will convert the Quality Inn & Suites Palm Island Indoor Waterpark property into two hotels — a 99-unit Holiday Inn and a 68-unit Candlewood Suites.

item.title: Planning for aerobatic championships includes more fuel sales, drawing thousands to 'international airport'
item.description: File Photo of Laura Wadhams.Photo by Joanne Beck Considering an air competition happening later this year isn’t expected to have any concessions, formal seating for spectators or fanfare in the way the Wings Over Batavia show has included, this one will be a boon for the area, drawing thousands of visitors from throughout the world, organizers say.
